answer.title: Nand Studio | Recording and Podcast Production
answer.text:
Nand Studio
Recording and podcast production in Atlanta.

We record interviews, narration and podcast episodes in our acoustically treated studio in Midtown. Remote sessions are available for guests across the country.

Services:
- Studio recording, two to four people
- Remote guest recording with a local backup track for each guest
- Editing, leveling and mastering
- Show notes and transcripts on request

Studio hours: Monday to Saturday, 10am to 8pm. Half-day and full-day blocks are available.

Rates start at $85 per hour for studio time. Remote session pricing is listed on request.

Contact us by email or call 404-555-0148 to check availability.
